user.title: Find your battery
user.description:
Look up your battery in the [BatteryLedger Store]({store_url}) ({count} batteries, list updated {updated}), or enter its details yourself.

{status}

store_search.title: Search the BatteryLedger Store
store_search.description: Filter the {count} batteries in the Store. Leave the search box empty to list everything that matches the filters.

data_description.region: Warranty terms often differ by country, so pick the one where the battery is installed.

store_confirm.title: {name}

manual.title: Enter battery details
manual.description: Use the figures from your manufacturer's datasheet and warranty for your country. Enter throughput in kWh (23.77 MWh = 23770 kWh).

data.reported_kwh: Capacity reported by the inverter per unit (kWh)

data_description.regions: Comma-separated country codes, e.g. AU, NZ.
data_description.throughput_table: Only for 'Table by unit count': one row per line as units=kWh, e.g. 3=60000.

group.title: {name}
group.description: How many units are installed, and when was the warranty start date (usually the install or commissioning date)? {error}

add_more.title: Battery groups

menu_options.store_search: Add another battery type from the Store

system.title: System and costs
system.description:
Choose the lifetime energy sensors from your inverter. At least one of charged or discharged energy is needed.

{detected}

data_description.cost: What you paid for the batteries, for cost per kWh and remaining value. Leave empty to skip the cost sensors.
data_description.reported_capacity_entity: The battery capacity your inverter reports, used to check the configured units match the hardware.
data_description.soh_entity: The health % your inverter reports, compared against the warranty floor.

sensors.title: Inverter integration
sensors.description: Which integration provides your battery's sensors? BatteryLedger has {count} sensor profiles for {brands} in the [Store]({store_url}) and has looked for their sensors in this Home Assistant. Choosing one fills in the sensors on the next step, where you can still change them.

modules.title: Battery modules

error.no_energy_entity: Choose at least one of the charged or discharged energy sensors.
error.bad_regions: Use two-letter country codes separated by commas, or GLOBAL.
error.throughput_required: Enter the throughput limit in kWh.
error.bad_table: Enter one row per line as units=kWh, e.g. 3=60000.
error.invalid_spec: Some figures don't add up (check usable vs nominal capacity, warranty years and end-of-life %).
error.bad_units: That unit count isn't valid for this battery.
error.future_date: The warranty start date can't be in the future.
error.not_detected: This integration's sensors weren't found in Home Assistant. Choose another, or choose sensors yourself.

error.no_energy_entity: Choose at least one of the charged or discharged energy sensors.

confirm.title: Updated spec for {model}

abort.spec_gone: This spec is no longer in use or no longer in the Store.
